xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3429

plan.title: merged story leaves xBRIEF in active/ because orphan-active is not on the merge path

narratives.Description: verify:orphan-active exists and is on pre-push task check, which is too early. After squash-merge the issue closes and the brief stays running in active/. Workers emit DONE with ISSUE: closed without scope:complete.
narratives.UserStory: As a through-merge parent, I want one after-merge orphan-active check per closed issue, so a shipped story cannot leave a running xBRIEF in active/.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add --issue N to verify:orphan-active (same check, one origin). Fail closed. Print the exact task scope:complete -- <path> line. drive-to: merge-ready DONE is illegal unless that check is exit 0 after merge. Parent runs the same check on MERGE / ISSUE-closed handback before the next dispatch. No new verb. No new ritual. swarm:complete-cohort stays the batch sweeper.
narratives.Overview: KISS: one existing gate, called after merge. One check: task verify:orphan-active -- --issue N. One remediation: task scope:complete -- <path>.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an active/ running brief whose origin issue is closed, when task verify:orphan-active -- --issue N runs, exit is 1 and output names task scope:complete -- <that-path>. Given --issue N with a still-open issue and unmerged PR, exit is 0 for that origin.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: PR 3432 merged 02f91b6738773774b8ffe134a2f100354f48c7e4; worktree CLI accepts --issue 3429; parent vendored CLI still lacks the flag until checkout updates

narrative.Acceptance: Given a merge-ready worker that squash-merged and closed #N, when it emits DONE, xbrief/active/ no longer holds that brief (it is in completed/) or the handback is BLOCKED with the complete error. Preamble / swarm after-merge contract names the same one check plus scope:complete remediation.
